sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Fraud Analyst in Noida at start 50, Data Analyst in Noida at start 0, and Risk Analyst in Delhi at start 25, then repeat the complete past-24-hour matrix and selected high-yield queries beyond start 50
sourceLanes.notes: The 26 saved checkpoints were retried first at low concurrency, followed by the complete 17-role-family by four-location matrix at starts 0, 25, and 50. The controlled pass completed 227 of 230 checkpoint-plus-fresh requests; only three network failures remain. Eight direct LinkedIn listings passed freshness, location, relevance, live-route, and deduplication gates: Surya Sangam Data & AI Intern, OnGrid Analyst I Operations Quality Assurance, NuvoRetail E-Commerce Analyst Trainee, Amazon Business Analyst OHL, Fortrea Clinical Data Analyst, Mobility Global Automotive Market Analyst, HPE Sales Process Analyst, and Fulfil Product Consultant Associate. Misleading same-day index refreshes were checked against direct posting dates; the old JPMorgan Product Associate result and other over-30-day or senior candidates were excluded. The full 116-role pre-update active audit found no closures.
